title: Are AI labs pelicanmaxxing?
summary: A thoughtful analysis exploring whether major AI laboratories are over-investing in or excessively focusing on PELICAN-style architectural approaches and scaling strategies, sparking discussion about strategic direction in AI development.
problem_solved: Examines potential over-concentration of AI research efforts in specific architectural paradigms and questions whether the industry is strategically balanced.
why_valuable: Prompts critical reflection on AI research priorities and investment strategies, encouraging more diverse approaches beyond dominant paradigms.
